Definition: of uncertain derivation; a buckler (or round shield); used of a serpent (as coiling itself), probably the "asp":--asp.
BiblicalUsage: Paul quotes the psalm that says the poison of asps is under men's lips, and the asp is the serpent whose bite kills quietly. The word appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Paul chose the serpent on purpose, because deadly speech does its harm before anyone feels the bite.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
